name: Firebase Realtime Database (Spark)
free_limit: Firebase Realtime Database on Spark: 1 GB stored, 10 GB downloaded/month and 100 simultaneous connections
watch_out: Spark requires no payment method and does not support multiple Realtime Database instances in one project. The 10 GB download quota is monthly (Blaze uses a different daily free allowance); excess Spark usage is restricted rather than silently becoming paid. Firebase Hosting and other products have separate limits.
